verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Customer.io's AI agent can run recurring deliverability reports on a schedule, which hints at some deliverability monitoring and possibly guidance. Nothing in the pack documents per-send bounce, complaint or blocklist metrics, or proactive alerts and remediation when deliverability degrades. Missing for 10: documented per-send bounce/complaint metrics, blocklist monitoring, degradation alerts with actionable guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
